request: Project managers should be able to see the full history of engagement with a country before starting a new mission.
gaps: What specific sensitive data needs to be protected in the engagement history?
What happens if a project manager leaves the organization or changes roles?
What is the retention policy for engagement history data?
How will access control be enforced and monitored?
How will engagement history be archived or deleted in accordance with data protection laws?

proposals.summary: This release will enable project managers to view the complete engagement history with each country prior to initiating a new mission. It will serve project managers within the Government CRM system to enhance their decision-making by providing relevant historical data.

core_commitments.text: Project managers can view the full engagement history for each country.

in_scope.text: Display a chronological list of all engagements with a country, including contact dates, meeting minutes, and outcomes.
Include filtering options for engagement history by date range and engagement type (e.g., meetings, correspondence, reports).
Ensure that only project managers have access to this feature.
Implement access control to protect sensitive data, adhering to appropriate data protection standards.

out_of_scope.text: This release will not allow editing or modification of engagement history.
This release does not include integration with external data sources for engagement history.
This release will not provide detailed analytics or reporting on engagement trends.

assumptions.text: Project managers have the necessary permissions to access engagement history.
assumptions.why_implicit: The request implies that project managers will need proper access rights to view the engagement history.

assumptions.text: Engagement history data exists and is reliably recorded in the CRM system.
assumptions.why_implicit: The request assumes that historical engagement information is stored in a manner that can be retrieved.

assumptions.text: Data protection laws permit project managers access to this engagement data.
assumptions.why_implicit: The request assumes compliance with data protection regulations regarding sensitive information.

definitions.definition: The complete record of all interactions with a country, including meetings, emails, reports, and any other documented communication.
Users in the CRM system designated to oversee and manage specific projects involving countries.
Any officially sanctioned initiative or project that the organization undertakes with a partnering country.

success_criteria.metric: Number of project managers accessing engagement history
success_criteria.target: 80% of project managers successfully access the engagement history of at least one country in the first month after launch.
success_criteria.measurement: Monitor usage statistics in the CRM system after the release.

C1.challenge: The proposal mentions access control to protect sensitive data, but it does not specify how this will be implemented or what sensitive data is included.
C1.failure_scenario: A project manager accesses sensitive engagement history records without proper access control, potentially exposing diplomatic communications to unintended individuals, leading to a data breach.
C1.resolution_test: What specific measures will be taken to ensure sensitive data within the engagement history is protected?

history.text: The proposal mentions access control to protect sensitive data, but it does not specify how this will be implemented or what sensitive data is included.

The proposal does not specify how access control will be implemented or what sensitive data is included.

I revised S4 to specify that access control will include logging attempts made to access sensitive engagement data, ensuring proper monitoring of access and compliance with data protection requirements. [changed: S4]
The proposal does not provide specific measures for how access control will be implemented beyond role-based permissions.

C2.challenge: The definition of 'full history of engagement' is unbounded as it does not specify the limitation on records, leading to uncertainty on what is included or excluded.
C2.failure_scenario: A project manager assumes 'full history' includes informal communications, leading to confusion or misinterpretation of the information retrieved and potentially violating data protection protocols.
C2.resolution_test: What is the exact scope of records included in the 'full history of engagement' and are there exclusions?

history.text: The definition of 'full history of engagement' is unbounded as it does not specify the limitation on records, leading to uncertainty on what is included or excluded.

I revised D1 to specify that 'full history of engagement' includes formal documented communications such as meeting minutes, reports, and official correspondence, explicitly excluding informal communications like personal emails or chat messages. [changed: D1]
The definition of 'full history of engagement' does not specify the limitation on records beyond the excluded informal communications.

I revised D1 to further specify that the 'full history of engagement' includes formal documented communications, such as meeting minutes and reports, while explicitly stating that only records from the last five years will be included, excluding informal communications, personal emails, and chat messages. The definition of 'full history of engagement' still lacks specific information regarding the limitations on records included, apart from excluded informal communications.
